Subject (in full) M.V. Elistratoff and G.G. Tichinin alias Tychinin,
"round the World" travellers.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the Officer i/c Special Branch
memorandum on the subject of Elistratoff and Tichinin, "round
the wordl" travellers, enquiries show that Mihail Vassilievitch
Elistratoff is a Russian born on October 31, 1897 in Samara
Province. He is an ex-officer of the White Russ□□ Army. He
escaped from Vladivostok in 1924 in a small boat in company
with one Colonel Vezelshikoff and his wife. Elistratoff ar-
rived in Shanghai from Seoul, Korea, in March, 1926. He
secured employment with the Shanghai Power Co. in September
1928, And on May 31, 1930 he left the Company on his own accord.
From July 7, 1930 until July 1, 1932 he was with the Russian
Regiment S.V.C. and was discharged from the Regiment owing to
bad health and bec□□e he contracted a venereal disease.
Georgy Ge□asimovitch Tichinin alias Tychinin is a
Russian born on March 31, 1902 in Orenourg Province. It is
reported that from 1922-2 he resided at Canton where he was
employed with Karnjal & Co. over two years; later he was in
the service of the Portu□uese Police at Shameen for over 1
year, subsequently he worked as a chauffeur mechanic. On
December 15, 1926 Tichinin arrived at Shanghai from Canton.
In Shanghai he had some casual work. On May 14, 1927 he left
again for Canton and was employed with the Portuguese Police
for 8 months and again returned to Shanghai, where since then
he has had some casual work. His last known address in
Shanghai was No.160 Avenue du Roi Albert.
Elistratoff and Tichinin left Shanghai for a "round
the world" tour on December 2, 1932 from the premises of Sokol,
a well known sporting organisation having branches in all
Slavonik Countries. Elistroff is a member of the Shanghai

事由（全称） M.V. Elistratoff 和 G.G. Tichinin（又名 Tychinin），“环球”旅行者。

撰写人 D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人 [签名]

关于特科主管警官就 Elistratoff 和 Tichinin 这两位“环球”旅行者一事所发的备忘录，经查询得知，Mihail Vassilievitch Elistratoff 系俄罗斯人，1897年10月31日出生于萨马拉省。他是前白俄□□军军官。1924年，他与一位 Vezelshikoff 上校及其妻子乘小船从符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）逃脱。Elistratoff 于1926年3月从朝鲜首尔抵达上海。1928年9月，他在上海电力公司获得职位，并于1930年5月31日自愿离职。从1930年7月7日至1932年7月1日，他隶属于俄罗斯团 S.V.C.，后因健康状况不佳并感染性病而被该团除名。
Georgy Ge□asimovitch Tichinin（又名 Tychinin）系俄罗斯人，1902年3月31日出生于奥伦堡省。据报，1922年至192?年间，他居住在广州，在 Karnjal & Co. 任职两年多；后来他在沙面葡萄牙警察部门服役一年多，随后担任司机兼机械师。1926年12月15日，Tichinin 从广州抵达上海。在上海期间，他做过一些零工。1927年5月14日，他再次前往广州，在葡萄牙警察部门任职8个月，之后又返回上海，此后一直做些零工。他在上海最后的已知地址是阿尔贝王路160号。
Elistratoff 和 Tichinin 于1932年12月2日从 Sokol 的驻地出发离开上海，进行“环球”旅行。Sokol 是一家著名的体育组织，在所有斯拉夫国家设有分支机构。Elistroff 自1930年9月1日起即为该组织上海

Branch of this organization since 1/9/30. Although Elistratoff
and Tichinin are making their tour under the auspices of "Sokol",
this organization does not pay their expenses.
According to their letter published in the local
Russian Newspaper "Shanghai Zaria" on August 1, 1933 they tra-
velled through Hangchow, Wuhu, Kiukiang, Nanking, Changsha and
Canton in about 7 months. When they sent this letter they were
staying in Yunan Province, and proposed to travel along
Mecong River to Burma and Siam.
Nothing detrimental is known by this office against
Elistratoff and Tichinin.

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.

分部的成员。尽管 Elistratoff 和 Tichinin 是在“Sokol”的赞助下进行此次旅行，但该组织并不支付他们的费用。
根据他们于1933年8月1日刊登在当地俄文报纸《上海霞光报》（Shanghai Zaria）上的信件，他们在约7个月内 traversed 杭州、芜湖、九江、南京、长沙和广州。发出此信时，他们正居住在云南省，并计划沿湄公河前往缅甸和暹罗。
本处未掌握任何对 Elistratoff 和 Tichinin 不利的信息。

G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
特科主管警官。
